# College Data Collection: the data dictionary and data-sharing classes

<!-- Generated by kb/_build_cdc_sharing.py from kb/cdc_data_dictionary.json. Edit the JSON, then run the builder. -->

Every field a college's page in College Data Collection (`#commons/data`) shows: what it is, the system it comes
from, its COMIS element where the repo records one, who may see it, and the key where a public record joins one
that is not public (#3310 item 4). The same definitions draw the card on each college's panel, the statewide card
and the view at `#commons/data/sharing`. The datasets themselves, their owners and procedures are in
[`data_dictionary`](data_dictionary.md).

## The four classes

- **Public.** Published by the college or the Chancellor's Office, or derived only from what they publish: the catalog, COCI, course outlines of record, program maps, C-ID and the COMIS course basic (CB) file. Anyone may read it, and COBI may pass it on.
- **Aggregate, not PII.** Student counts from MAP or the COMIS Data Mart, published only as counts and suppressed below the minimum cell size. The rule is the student-detail disclosure ADR (docs/kb-notes/adr-student-detail-aggregate-disclosure-control.md): a cell backed by fewer than 10 distinct students is suppressed, at write time, with complementary suppression wherever a total is published. Three older surfaces keep their own floors under adr-cer-student-impact-counts-privacy: the CER's public students-served counts mask below 5, and the per-college cohort counts (students, veterans, working adults, apprentices) mask below 2; the funding counts mask below 10 (adr-funding-priority-metrics-privacy).
- **Needs an agreement.** Held or passed on only under a data-sharing agreement or the holder's written permission. COBI shows its status and, where one exists, an aggregate; never the record itself.
- **Held for the team.** For the team's own work in COBI or MAP. COBI's own status files may serve it to the tab; it is left out of any outside share by default.

## The join keys

Each key that joins a public record to another record, and the other record's class.

| Join key | Definition | Public side | Other side | Other side's class | COMIS element |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Program control number | COCI's number for an approved program. It joins the public program record (catalog, COCI, program maps) to program awards reported to COMIS. | The program's catalog record, its COCI record and its program map | Program awards in COMIS, counted by control number | Needs an agreement | none (The issue names SP04; the repo's own reference files do not record the SP element ids, so the id is left empty.) |
| Award type | The kind of award a program leads to (an associate degree, a certificate and so on). It sorts program awards on both sides of the control-number join. | The program's COCI record | Program awards in COMIS | Needs an agreement | none (The issue names SP02; the repo's own reference files do not record the SP element ids, so the id is left empty.) |
| Course control number | COCI's number for an approved course. It joins the public course record (catalog, COCI, the outline) to the course basic record in COMIS. | The course's catalog entry, its COCI record and its outline of record | The COMIS course basic (CB) record | Public | CB_CONTROL_NUMBER (The column name in kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv; the element number is not in the repo.) |
| TOP code | The Taxonomy of Programs code a college assigns to a course or program. Faculty-entered and unreliable, so COBI uses it to corroborate or filter, never to decide identity. | The course's and the program's COCI record | The COMIS course basic record | Public | CB_TOP_CODE (The column name in kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv; the element number is not in the repo.) |
| MIS college code | The three-character code COMIS uses for a college (Appendix A of the MIS Data Element Dictionary). It joins CDC's college to every COMIS file and Data Mart figure. | CDC's college identity crosswalk | COMIS files and the Data Mart's aggregates | Aggregate, not PII | CB_COLLEGE_ID (The column name in kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv; the codes are in kb/reference/mis_district_college_codes.json.) |
| Course and college | A college's local course, named by the college and its course. It joins a CPL articulation in MAP to the aggregate CPL counts for that course. | The college's course in its catalog and COCI | MAP's CPL articulations and the aggregate CPL counts | Aggregate, not PII | none |
| C-ID number | The C-ID descriptor a course is approved against. It joins a college's course to the common descriptor and to MAP's articulation rows, which carry the same number. | C-ID's approved courses | MAP's articulation rows (CID Number) | Aggregate, not PII | none |

## Agreements

Status only, never an agreement's text. A status the repo does not record reads "not recorded".

| Agreement | Parties | Status | Covers | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MAP data access | The Chancellor's Office CPL Initiative and MAP (RCCD / InfoTech) | exists | The nightly MAP custom-report API pull and the gated tables it loads. | Named as existing in the conductor's reply on #3310 (2026-11-14). The agreement itself is not recorded in the repo. |
| Chancellor's Office data lake and dataset APIs | The Chancellor's Office research and data staff | might be needed | API access to the Chancellor's Office datasets and data lakes. | The CPL Initiative will ask for access (#3310). Not recorded as asked. |
| COMIS program awards by control number | The Chancellor's Office institutional research and MIS | might be needed | Program award counts by control number and award type, as aggregates. | The drafted request is not in this repo or the vault; its status is not recorded. |
| COMIS student-level files | The Chancellor's Office institutional research and MIS | might be needed | The MAP-to-MIS student match that would count students with CPL statewide. | Falls under the student-detail disclosure ADR (docs/reference/data_sources.md, MIS). |
| COMIS course basic file | The Chancellor's Office MIS unit | not recorded | The Fall 2025 CB course file the team was supplied. | The terms it was supplied under are not recorded in the repo. The file is on the public site (kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv), as the Chancellor's Office course file publishes the course elements. |
| JST authorizations through CCCStart | The Chancellor's Office, its General Counsel and the CCC Technology Center | pending | Ordering the authorized students' Joint Services Transcripts and loading them to MAP per college. | Waits on the General Counsel's procedural OK; no data-sharing agreement, since the student's CCCApply authorization governs (docs/reference/data_sources.md). |
| DIR-DAS apprenticeship MOU | The Chancellor's Office and DIR-DAS | exists | Matching apprentice records with CCC records for research and aggregate reports. | A revision extending disclosure to designated agents and districts is pending review (docs/reference/data_sources.md). |
| Program Pathways Mapper access | The Foundation for California Community Colleges | might be needed | An export or API for the program maps colleges publish. | A note asking for access was drafted on 2026-10-17; not recorded as sent. |
| College and district system access | Each college or district, with MAP | might be needed | Reading a college's student information system or curriculum system through its API. | Per college; none is recorded in the repo. |
| Outside partners reading the Commons | WestEd, Credential Engine and other partners | might be needed | Partners reading Commons data beyond what is public. | Public elements need none; anything beyond them would. Not recorded as asked. |

| CDC's college identity crosswalk | The CPL Initiative (MAP team) | kb/college_identity/<date>/crosswalk.json: each college's name, district, MAP college id and MIS college code. |

| COCI, the Chancellor's Office Curriculum Inventory | The Chancellor's Office | Each college's approved programs and courses, by control number; COBI reads them from coci_college_programs and coci_program_courses. |

| COBI's program source registry | The CPL Initiative (MAP team and COBI) | program_source_registry: whether a catalog link, a curriculum view and a pathway source are held for the college. |
| Program Pathways Mapper (PPM) | The Foundation for California Community Colleges | Program maps colleges publish. |
| MAP, the Mapping Articulated Pathways platform | MAP (RCCD / InfoTech) | The system of record for CPL; COBI reads it through the MAP custom-report API. |
| COMIS, the Chancellor's Office Management Information Systems data | The Chancellor's Office MIS unit | What each district reports each term; COBI holds one Fall 2025 course basic (CB) file (kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv). |
| The COMIS Data Mart | The Chancellor's Office MIS unit | Public aggregates at datamart.cccco.edu. |
| Centers of Excellence labor market data | The Centers of Excellence | Regional occupation demand; COBI holds a hand export (kb/reference/coe_occupation_demand_2024_2029.json). |
| C-ID | ASCCC (the C-ID system) | Course descriptors and the courses approved against them (kb/reference/cid_articulations.json). |
| The college's own systems | The college or its district | Its student information system (SIS) and the curriculum system that holds its course outlines. |
